personal.viewDesc_focus: Minimal; Favourites and your work come first
personal.editDisabledDemo: Editing is disabled on the demo account
personal.logoEditLabel: Company logo — drag to move freely, arrow keys to nudge, + / − to resize, Esc to finish
personal.logoFreeEditLabel: Company logo — drag it anywhere on the page or into the empty area below the left menu; resize from the corners; arrow keys nudge (Shift for larger steps), + / − resize, Esc finishes
personal.logoKept: The logo does not fit the requested position at this screen width; it is shown at its last valid position.
personal.logoNoFit: At this screen width the logo does not fit its saved position and there is no free space nearby. Drag it to an empty area or make it smaller.
personal.logoRejected: The logo would not fit with this change; the last valid position was kept.
personal.logoDropInvalid: The logo cannot be dropped here: it would cover the Yaşam Sistemi area, the welcome text, buttons or cards, or leave the page. It stayed at its last valid position.
personal.logoFrameMissing: This area is not visible right now (e.g. the left menu is collapsed or the mobile drawer is closed).

personalNotices.conflict: The design was changed in another tab. The latest version has been loaded.
personalNotices.historyLoaded: The previous design has been loaded into the draft.
personalNotices.resetDone: Returned to the default Yaşam Sistemi view. Hidden modules and My Favourites were kept.
personalNotices.factoryResetDone: Returned to the original Yaşam Sistemi home screen. Your design history and uploaded images were kept.
personalNotices.prefsResetFailed: Your personal design was removed, but your view preferences (hidden modules, My Favourites, view mode) could not be reset. Please try again.

personalReadability.insufficient: Readability is insufficient — choose a different focus/tone
personalReadability.unmeasured: Not measured — it is measured once the photo is uploaded
